project.name: KHKD - Wolbachia Vi Khuan Doi Gioi Tinh
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — vi khuan Wolbachia doi gioi tinh con trung
project.story: Wolbachia is a bacterium living inside the cells of more than half of all insect species on Earth. It hijacks insect reproduction in unbelievable ways: kills male embryos, converts genetic males into females, sterilizes males that mate with uninfected females, and even makes infected mothers' male offspring vanish. The result: in many species, the male sex is being slowly erased and the population is becoming almost entirely female.
